title: Diwali Grocery kits distribution
summary: rcmic extended help/participating in their endeavor to bring smiles of lesser privilege strata of society during Diwali festivities.
description: rcmic extended help/participating in their endeavor to bring smiles of lesser privilege strata of society during Diwali festivities. They plan to distribute grocery kits consisting of besan/ghee/sugar and basic items to make sweets during the festivals season. Each kit costs Rs. 500/- for distribution.
